gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-hanuman: Hanuman carries a classic serif refinement, its high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals feeling traditional. And Wallpoet, with its bold, smooth-bending display letters, does the shouting that Hanuman is too well-mannered to attempt.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noticia-text: Wallpoet is all bold, commanding display, with high-rising lowercase. Noticia Text follows in a literary serif whose wide curve entrances and tall lowercase bodies give the loud heading a dignified, steady companion underneath.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-piazzolla: Loud meets learned here. Wallpoet's smooth bends and high-rising lowercase look bold and commanding, and Piazzolla, a classic serif with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, brings the refined authority that settles it down.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-scope-one: Scope One is a text serif with a big x-height and counters that spill outward, traditional and refined. But Wallpoet takes the commanding role above it, its see-through lines giving the page a loud, bold start.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-slabo-13px: Wallpoet makes a bold, commanding entrance, its lowercase rising high and its lines showing paper between the letters. Slabo 13px follows with a bookish serif, large open counters keeping its dignified tone readable beneath all that noise.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified, even under a loud heading. Wallpoet brings the bold display punch, while Suwannaphum, a serif with a high squared-off x-height and a wide-open c, keeps paragraphs feeling editorial all the way down.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-epunda-slab: Expressive ink strokes, drawn as if with one pen tip. Epunda Slab then settles things as a text serif, and its body size is worth nudging up so the gaping c and tall rounded forms show.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-fauna-one: Literary, yes, but with a loud neighbor. Warnes keeps its lines the same width through every turn, expressive and bold, while Fauna One's tall middle band and generous e eye supply a dignified serif foil.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-glegoo: Refined and editorial on one side, expressive on the other. Glegoo brings big counters and wide, unclosed curves in a tall lowercase, so Warnes, with no stress in its curves, gets a worthy foil.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-hanuman: Pen-tip ink, bold and stretched out. Warnes earns its keep when big and short, its curves never thinning at the turns, while Hanuman, a traditional text serif, handles the refined high-waisted lowercase.
